subject.title: Flaky tests on Windows/WSL: timeouts and ENOENT in pi-tools workspace-paths & safe-bins

question: Should https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90273 remove its closing reference to this issue so the original, now-obsolete pi-tools report can close independently?
rationale: The linked PR changes a different test module, and automation should not redefine the scope of this issue or edit the contributor’s claimed relationship without maintainer intent.

options.title: Remove the unrelated closing link
options.body: Treat the fs-safe hardlink PR as independent, remove its closing relationship, and close this issue after confirming the current-main source assessment.

options.title: Broaden this issue’s scope
options.body: Explicitly redefine this issue as a general Windows test-coverage umbrella and retain the closing relationship, accepting that this changes the original problem statement.

recommendation.title: Remove the unrelated closing link
recommendation.body: Treat the fs-safe hardlink PR as independent, remove its closing relationship, and close this issue after confirming the current-main source assessment.
